|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E3 (version 4 of 5) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Escape Pod & We're Doomed (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-Escape_Pod_and_Were_Doomed-2022-06-01-e8445f0.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-L-Escape_Pod_and_Were_Doomed-2022-06-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-L-Escape_Pod_and_Were_Doomed-2021-09-03-b4a011a.gif]], 3 September 2021) → [[File:V4-L-Escape_Pod_and_Were_Doomed-2022-06-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-L-Escape_Pod_and_Were_Doomed-2022-06-01-e8445f0.gif]], 1 June 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 3 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Escape Pod & We're Doomed]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-escapepodweredoomed022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/escapepodweredoomed.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Light/large/escapepodweredoomed.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “We’re Doomed”. Text: “Use 1 Force to take a dejarik into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR For remainder of turn, you lose no Force to Cloud City Occupation, Rebel Base Occupation, Tatooine Occupation, That Thing's Operational, or You May Start Your Landing.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Escape Pod & We're Doomed (Errata)]]): PC errata sheet slip (Errata_090321.pdf, page 1), PDF dated 3 September 2021<ref name="slip-escapepod-090321">Players Committee errata sheet [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata_090321.pdf#page=1 Errata_090321.pdf], page 1 (“Official text as of September 3, 2021”); the date is the PDF's creation date (3 September 2021).</ref> (the sheet says “Official text as of September 3, 2021”). '''What changed:''' “Thing's Operational, or You May” → “Thing's Operational, You May”; “Start Your Landing.” → “Start Your Landing, or You'll Be Dead!”; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); a different printing: the errata sheet slip (printed for sleeving over the card) replaces the card image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “We’re Doomed”. Text: “Use 1 Force to take a dejarik into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR For remainder of turn, you lose no Force to Cloud City Occupation, Rebel Base Occupation, Tatooine Occupation, That Thing's Operational, You May Start Your Landing, or You'll Be Dead!”

Text: “Use 1 Force to take a dejarik into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR For remainder of turn, you lose no Force to Cloud City Occupation, Rebel Base Occupation, Tatooine Occupation, That Thing's Operational, You May Start Your Landing, or You'll Be Dead!”
